meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析当前代码变更，结合知识图谱找出改了哪些文件、哪些组件受影响、涉及哪些架构层，并评估风险。最后生成一个可视化用的对比文件。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 git diff 或 pull request 时触发。

say.text: 分析我当前的代码变更，有哪些风险？
say.note: Claude 会输出变更组件和风险评估。

say.text: 看看这个 PR 改了什么，影响哪些模块？
say.note: 会列出受影响组件和架构层。

say.text: 对比我的分支和主分支的差异。
say.note: 会分析变更并生成可视化数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes code changes against a knowledge graph to identify what files changed, affected components, architectural layers, and risks. It also generates a diff overlay file for visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a git diff or pull request.

say_en.text: Analyze my current code changes and assess risks.
say_en.note: Claude outputs changed components and risk assessment.

say_en.text: What did this PR change and which modules are affected?

say_en.note: Analyzes diff and generates visualization data.
